timeline.title: Gift Part.1

reasons.label_en: Baseline from the last album's sales
A longer gap than usual since the previous album (usually costs sales)
Full album: usually sells more than a mini album

timeline.explain_note: Older album: explained with today's model, which learned from 2019+ releases. Instagram data and part of the retail-chart data did not exist yet, so those reasons cannot show here.
